This is device internet state, not VPN tunnel state.
The official WireGuard tunnel library is integrated. A valid profile and Android system VPN consent are required to create a tunnel.

The app shell and local preferences remain available offline. The WireGuard profile is stored encrypted outside the device backup area; a network path to the VPN server is still required to establish a tunnel.

An active engine does not by itself prove a successful server handshake or internet reachability.
